daas-irab:1-1.t: ﴿قُلْ﴾ an imperative verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya), with no grammatical position. ﴿أَعُوذُ﴾ an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent. ﴿بِرَبِّ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْفَلَقِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿مِنْ شَرِّ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعوذ. ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿خَلَقَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause).

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿وَمِنْ شَرِّ﴾ the two are conjoined (maʿṭūfān) to what precedes them. ﴿غاسِقٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿وَقَبَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).

daas-irab:4-4.t: ﴿وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثاتِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿فِي الْعُقَدِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) what precedes them.

daas-irab:5-5.t: ﴿وَمِنْ شَرِّ حاسِدٍ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf) to what precedes it. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān). ﴿حَسَدَ﴾ a past verb whose fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa).
